entities.summary: Darren Michael Langdon is a Canadian professional ice hockey coach and former player. Undrafted, he signed his first professional contract in 1993 with the New York Rangers. After retiring from the National Hockey League (NHL), Langdon coached a former team, the Deer Lake Red Wings of the Newfoundland Senior Hockey League (NSHL). While playing in the NHL, Langdon was best known for his fighting ability as an enforcer.
